{{Quote|This is Major Wes Janson, and if you're not aware of his exploits, I'm sure he'll be delighted to give you the whole story.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="X-wing: Starfighters of Adumar">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>}}
'''Wes Janson''' {{Pronounced|Wěs Jǎn'-sǔn}} was an [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Janson first joined the Alliance prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], but contracted an [[Hesken Fever|illness]] that prevented him from flying in that engagement. He later served with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], the Rebellion's most elite starfighter [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]. As a key member of the Rogues, he fought at the battles of [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Endor]], among others. After Endor, Janson flew in multiple engagements as part of Rogue Squadron, including covering the defection of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]]. Following that mission, Rogue Squadron was temporarily disbanded and Janson, along with his good friend [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]], were assigned to train new pilots. He would later go on to serve with [[Wraith Squadron]], the New Republic's pilot/[[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit. Janson was the first executive officer of the squadron and saw action both in space and on the ground during commando missions against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]. After Zsinj was [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|defeated]], Janson transferred back to Rogue Squadron. Janson eventually reached the rank of [[Major/Legends|Major]] after years of service fighting against the Galactic Empire, including in campaigns against [[Prince-Admiral/Legends|Prince-Admiral]] [[Delak Krennel]] and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], as well as a diplomatic mission to [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]].

Janson retired from active service after the end of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], but returned to serve the New Republic by leading a [[Taanab Yellow Aces|group]] of volunteers during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The Yellow Aces were heavily involved at the [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|Battle of Borleias]], garnering a reputation as an elite unit. After the Yuuzhan Vong surrender, Janson retired again, but peace was fleeting. He would once again return to combat in the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], joining [[Rakehell Squadron]] in support of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] insurgency against [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], who had fallen to the dark side. Janson flew in the [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Centerpoint]], providing cover for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] infiltration teams.

==Biography==
===Early Galactic Civil War===
[[File:WesJanson-SWM.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Wes Janson, circa [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].]]
Wes Janson, a native of [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]], originally joined the Rebel Alliance as a member of the [[Tierfon Yellow Aces/Legends|Tierfon Yellow Aces]], a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] training squadron during the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The group was based out of the [[Tierfon Rebel Outpost|Tierfon Rebel Base]]. The aim of the Yellow Aces was to engage pilots in technically "active" missions, but to avoid pitting them against too hazardous of a situation in preparation for more dangerous duties in the future.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>

As a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] of the Yellow Aces, Janson racked up an impressive kill record and earned a tremendous reputation.<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> However, it was on one of his first missions with them that Janson was faced with a difficult decision. The Yellow Aces were tasked with ambushing an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoy carrying supplies that the Alliance needed badly. When the convoy arrived at their destination, its armed escort was larger than anticipated. 

One pilot, [[Kissek Doran]], was suddenly struck with panic and tried to leave the group. With the prospect of compromising the entire ambush party if he was detected by the Imperials, Janson and [[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Jek Tono Porkins]] were ordered to bring him back. Since using his [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] would potentailly give away their position, Janson was forced to use his lasers, destroying the fleeing pilot&mdash;it was his first kill. Despite the necessity of the action, and the fact that Doran may have survived if his scrounged [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]] hadn't been in such poor condition, [[Tainer family|his family]] blamed Janson for his death and the percieved ruination of their family name.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

Nevertheless, Janson's service with the Yellow Aces was considered exemplary. He was quickly promoted to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] and was awarded the rank of [[True Gunner]] for "consistent excellence and superior performance as an officer and a gunner," according to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] at a Tierfon Fighter Base awards ceremony. While with the Yellow Aces, Janson formed a strong friendship with Porkins, nicknamed "Piggy." Coming out of the same training class, they quickly bonded. Janson would often recall some rather tall tales of their days together at [[Tierfon/Legends|Tierfon]].<ref name="GG3" /> He also met [[Tomer Darpen/Legends|Tomer Darpen]] in the squadron, whom he would later encounter on [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]].<ref name="X-wing: Starfighters of Adumar" />

With the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]] and the threat of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], the Yellow Aces were placed on "full active" duty. An emergency list was compiled of pilots who would be transferred to [[Great Temple/Legends|Yavin Base]]. Wes Janson was on that list. However, at the time of the transfer, Janson was stricken with [[Hesken Fever]], having contracted it while on a scouting mission, and was unable to go. Even though the ailing Janson firmly insisted on his ability to fly, a replacement was named to fill his slot on the transfer list. That someone was Jek Porkins. Porkins never returned from the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|assault]] on the Death Star, and Janson often blamed himself for the death of his friend. From that point forward, he vowed to fly to honor his fallen friend. Future heroics would help alleviate some of the guilt and pain he carried with him.<ref name="Databank:Wes Janson" /><ref name="GG3" />

===Joining Rogue Squadron===
{{Quote|Cable out let it go.|Janson, during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]|<ref name="Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
Wes Janson was among the first crop of pilots to join the new [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Flight]]<ref name="Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> under the command of Rebel pilot and aspiring [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] after the destruction of the Death Star. With the Rogues, Janson was permanently assigned to the roving [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] group. He performed well in several skirmishes during the [[Thila/Legends|Thila]] evacuation, helping Rogue Flight prove their worth. [[0 ABY/Legends|Six months]] after [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin]], he participated in the campaign against [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kohl Seerdon]], including action at the [[Raid on Balmorra]], where he helped to cripple the Empire's production of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] for some time; and the [[Attack on Thyferra|Second Battle of Thyferra]], which saw the death of Seerdon.<ref name="GG3" /><ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>

As a member of the Rogues, Janson became immediate friends with fellow pilot [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]. The two would often fly as one another's wingman. During several training maneuvers, Janson saved his friend's [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] from being painted by target-drone beams by destroying them long before Antilles realized there was a problem. The two also shared numerous interests, including a mutual appreciation for both [[Corellian ale/Legends|Corellian ale]] and [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].<ref name="GG3" />

On one [[Mission to Kwenn Space Station|mission]], while scouting for a new Rebel base location, Janson and the rest of the Rogues were on [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]]. After they observed the Empire taking over a freighter, the ''[[Stellar Manx]]'', the Rogues decided to investigate. Three pilots, Wedge Antilles, [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], and Janson, disguised themselves and entered [[Hangar 872-H]]. While viewing the ''Stellar Manx'', they were confronted by a group of stormtroopers. The three Rebel pilots evaded the troopers and eventually liberated the crew of the freighter from Imperial custody, as well as capturing the ship itself. During this operation, they discovered that the ''Stellar Manx'' was on a secret mission bound for [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]] to meet with [[Frap Radicon]] to research gravity well technology. This plan was later disrupted by the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Rogue Squadron to the Rescue">''[[Star Wars Missions 18: Rogue Squadron to the Rescue]]''</ref>

Janson also flew a [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeder]] on a terrestrial mission alongside Antilles some time after the Battle of Yavin. During the mission, while dogfighting against Imperial TIEs, Antilles requested that Janson take a look at his speeder and check it for problems. A flabbergasted Janson reported that Antilles had a Wookiee hanging from his craft&mdash;[[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. Thankfully for the Wookiee and Antilles, the Rebels pulled off a mid-air boarding maneuver that allowed Chewbacca to steal a TIE fighter and return safely.<ref name="Star Wars: Chewbacca 3">[[Chewbacca (2000) 3|''Chewbacca'' (2000) 3]]</ref>

When High Command relocated to the newly established [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], Janson was transferred there along with the rest of Rogue Group. Due to his renowned gunnery abilities and the supplement of pilots serving with Rogue Group to operate their two-seated [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]], Janson was assigned to be Antilles' rear gunner. When the Empire located Echo Base and launched a subsequent [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|assault]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Janson and Antilles were able to bring down the first AT-AT walker during the battle, employing a [[Rogue Doctrine|tactic]] that involved using the speeder's [[Power harpoon launcher|harpoon and tow cable]] to trip the walker's legs. Their snowspeeder was shot down during the battle, though Janson and Antilles suffered no major injuries. They abandoned their craft and made it safely back to the base where they prepared to evacuate. Janson then manned the rear gunner position of a [[BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter]], with fellow Rogue [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek "Hobbie" Klivian]] at the controls, for the run through the Imperial blockade of the planet. Along with Antilles and Skywalker in their X-wings, the three ships ingeniously used the [[Tallon split]] to help the [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] [[Thon's Orchard/Legends|''Thon's Orchard'']] escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. From there, Janson regrouped with the rest of the Rogues at the secret [[Haven (rendezvous point)|rendezvous point]].<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook" /><ref name="GG3" /><ref name="Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back" />
Antilles would later tell new recruits about him and Janson being stranded on Hoth for months, with Janson eventually being slain at the hands of scavengers, only to have Janson emerge, alive and well.<ref name="Hoth: Under the Ice">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031218hoth3|series=Hoth: Under the Ice|text=Part 3: Merchants of Death}}</ref><ref name="Star Wars 78: Hoth Stuff">[[Star Wars (1977) 78|''Star Wars'' (1977) 78]]</ref>

Due to the loss of several Rogue pilots, in the aftermath of Hoth, Janson had to man the pilot's seat of an X-wing.<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook" />

===Helping the search for Solo===
During Luke Skywalker and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] attempt to rescue [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], Janson, as part of Rogue Squadron, was based on the moon of [[Kile]] at a temporary facility set up for them. Skywalker's plan had them attack two entire wings of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]], plus two [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] in a surprise raid on [[Gall/Legends|Gall]]. The real purpose of the assault was to make a distraction, allowing the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and the [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']] to reach Fett's craft and rescue Han.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>

When the Imperials launched more TIE fighters, Skywalker called for a retreat as the Rogues were beginning to take casualties. However, [[Unidentified R2 unit (Wes Janson)|Janson's astromech droid]] suddenly took control of his X-wing. Programmed by a bribed technician, his ship began shooting at Skywalker's X-wing, with Janson powerless to stop it. Janson however was unable to seal his [[Flight suit/Legends|fluit suit]] and [[Ejector seat/Legends|eject]] over Gall. Thankfully for Janson, Skywalker managed to disable Janson's rogue droid without causing any injury to him. The mission was a failure, and back on Kile, [[Viera Cheran]]'s role in the incident was discovered.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire" /><ref name="SOTE Sourcebook" /> 

Back to the fleet, they received a [[message pod]] from [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]], with information that the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] were on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Janson and the other Rogues waited at the outskirts of the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]]. Janson, as well as Wedge, were waiting in the [[sensor shadow]] under [[Cargo barge]]s. Once they got a message from [[LE-BO2D9/Legends|Leebo]],<ref>{{WEGCite|story=Let's Go!|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>  they participated in the [[Battle over Coruscant]] against forces of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal empire while escorting the ''Millennium Falcon'' to safety from a mission to rescue Leia Organa from Black Sun captivity. Ultimately, the intervention of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], particularly the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], resulting in the destruction of the Black Sun [[Xizor/Legends|leader's]] [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]] allowed the Rogues and the ''Falcon'' to escape in the confusion.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire" />

===Endor and beyond===
{{Quote|Hey Wedge, where'd all the gnurled bandits come from?|Wes Janson, on [[Cilpar]]|<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: The Rebel Opposition">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: The Rebel Opposition]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Gorax2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Wes and Tycho under attack by a Gorax after the Battle of Endor.]]
Janson flew with [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Group]]<ref name="The Briefing of Red Group" /> in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], where he rendered "meritorious service" as a pilot.<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Leader">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing: Rogue Leader]]''</ref> He also flew in the [[Battle of Bakura]].<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> After returning from Bakura, Janson and Tycho Celchu were assigned to ground patrol on the surface of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] in search of an Imperial patrol that the native [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] had told the Alliance about. During the patrol, Janson and Celchu were attacked by a [[Gorax/Legends|gorax]]&mdash;however, Janson's skill with a blaster pistol allowed him to kill the beast with a single blast to the eye. After the incident, they were recalled to base and given a new assignment under Luke Skywalker.<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Leader" />

On this mission, Janson accompanied Skywalker, Celchu, [[Ten Numb/Legends|Ten Numb]] and Antilles to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] as part of the under-strength Rogue Squadron. Janson and the other Rogues, having not found any trace of the Empire, were enjoying themselves in a local tapcafe when they were attacked by Imperial forces, who had come to reclaim the planet. Recovering from the assault, the Rogues counter-attacked and pursued Imperial General [[Weir/Legends|Weir]]. Weir, however, escaped Corellia after capturing Numb. Janson, Antilles, and Skywalker pursued Weir on [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], but Weir managed to escape on a transport. Celchu and the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2]] units brought the pilots their craft and the Rogues pursued the fleeing general. Distracted by a suicide fighter attack on a civilian convoy, Rogue Squadron was delayed long enough for Weir to flee to [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]], but Skywalker, Janson, and the others followed them into Tralus's tunnels. With the aid of native [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]], the Rogues tracked down Weir's base and attacked it in an attempt to save Numb. Janson and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], splitting up from the others, were able to find Numb, but the Sullustan pilot had already been killed. After returning from the mission to Tralus, Antilles took over the squadron, with Janson continuing to be a part of the squadron even after its reorganization.<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Leader" />

====Shot down on Cilpar====
{{Quote|Can you handle a blaster?''"<br />"''Do garrals have freckles?|Tycho Celchu and Wes Janson|<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: The Rebel Opposition" />}}
[[File:Tycho_rescues_Wes.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Tycho carries a wounded Wes Janson.]]
On a [[Mission to Cilpar|mission]] to [[Cilpar]] Janson was shot down by enemy TIE fighters, and crash-landed on the planet, breaking his leg and a number of ribs in the process. Celchu managed to land his fighter and find the injured Janson, and carried him to a nearby cave, tending to his wounds while waiting for rescue, though Janson was unimpressed by Celchu's cooking.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: The Rebel Opposition" />

While in the cave, Celchu and Janson met up with [[Winter Celchu|Winter]], who was disguised as Princess Leia. Winter gave Celchu a new assignment, sending him to impersonate an Imperial officer and infiltrate the local garrison while she stayed with Janson. While Janson and Winter were in the cave, Janson was able to learn Celchu's history from her.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: The Rebel Opposition" />

After some time Winter left Janson for a short period, and went to check on Celchu's fighter&mdash;however, during the inspection the fighter took off with her inside of it. Having managed to return to the cave after defeating a flight of TIE fighters, Winter and Janson remained in hiding. However, a member of the local resistance who was aiding the Rogues was actually an Imperial spy. He brought the Empire to the cave and both Winter and Janson were captured and taken to the local Moff's palace, with Winter being mistaken for the real Princess Leia. Having arrived at the palace, the Imperials kept Janson in the infirmary due to his injuries rather than a cell or even in the Moff's company, as Winter was.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: The Rebel Opposition" />

The successful attacks from an anti-Imperial insurgent named [[Elscol Loro]] and Antilles' Rogues allowed the Rebels to capture the Moff and rescue Janson, liberating Cilpar from the Empire in the process.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: The Rebel Opposition" />

====Mission to Mrlsst====
{{Quote|C'mon, Wedge, you know me! Fighting is a way of life for me! Two days without blowing up some TIE fighters and I can't sleep properly!|Wes Janson, to Wedge Antilles|<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: The Phantom Affair">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: The Phantom Affair]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Wes_Janson_-_PA.jpg|thumb|300px|Wes Janson during the Mission to Mrlsst.]]
Following his rescue on Cilpar, Janson remained convalescent in a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] while the other Rogues, with Elscol Loro newly added, were tasked with the escort of a convoy to Mrlsst&mdash;along the way they fought off an attacking Imperial fleet. During the defense, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Groznik]], in the shuttle with Janson, grew quite anxious at Loro being placed in danger due to his [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]] to her, which aggravated Janson. Spending the first few days or so in a Mrlssti hospital, Janson was present when a warrant was issued for their arrest after they were implicated in stealing the datacards of the [[Phantom Project]], an experimental weapon desired by both the Empire and Rebellion, though the datacard was actually a fake. Breaking out of the hospital on the repulsor bed and still clad in pajamas, Janson, accompanied by several other Rogue pilots, Groznik, and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Terrik]], made their way out of the city, chased by Imperials. Shooting out the safety control on Janson's repulsor bed, the Rogues flew up to the top of Mrlssti's [[greenstalk]] trees, finding refuge in a treetop village, and out-distancing their pursuit.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: The Phantom Affair" />

Janson, apparently healthy enough to fight, joined [[Isplourrdacartha Estillo|Plourr Ilo]] and Klivian in rescuing Antilles, who had been captured by the Empire. Little did they know that Antilles had already managed to escape from Imperial custody. The group was mostly united when the Empire decided to attack Mrlsst out of vengeance for the destruction of the Phantom Project datacards. Janson helped defend the planet from the attack, and the use of another experimental Mrlssti superweapon forced the Empire to withdraw after heavy losses.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: The Phantom Affair" />

====Battle on Tatooine====
{{Quote|Plourr, try to remember that we're supposed to keep a low profile.|Wes Janson, to Plourr Ilo|<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: Battleground: Tatooine">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Battleground: Tatooine]]''</ref>}}
Following their return from Mrlsst, Janson&mdash;now fully recovered&mdash;and the other Rogues went to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in support of an Alliance agent (later revealed to be Winter). Janson, Klivian, Ilo, and [[Dllr Nep]] were sent to check out the local lowlifes and to investigate the intensity of the gang wars that had sprung up in the wake of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] death. Janson's group went to a local [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on Nep's recommendation, which Janson later reflected was a bad idea&mdash;he thought the band was awful, Ilo got into a barfight, and the group was kicked out. Outside of the cantina, the group was hired by a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] to cause some trouble at a local ranch, but without bloodshed, since his original employees had been beaten by Ilo. Janson agreed, for the price of eight hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], over Ilo's objections, having noticed the man's military-grade blaster. Janson wanted to play along until he could determine what the Devaronian was actually planning, not knowing that the target was the [[Huff Darklighter|Darklighter]] farm where Antilles, Celchu, Loro, and Winter were. Janson's group was to be a diversion to allow Winter unnoticed access to Darklighter's safe, but another group of raiders attacked the Darklighter residence first and a pair of [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] stole the datadisks that Winter sought.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: Battleground: Tatooine" />

[[File:Wes_and_Dllr.jpg|thumb|left|375px|Wes and Dllr on Tatooine "enjoying" the music at a local cantina.]]
Accompanied by the Devaronian, the group set out for the farm, but stopped after they noticed that it had already been attacked. Janson attempted to interrogate the Devaronian, but he refused to answer and resisted them. Winter and Celchu flew by on a speeder in pursuit of the Rodians, but their speeder was shot down, and they joined Janson's group, where Winter identified the Devaronian as her associate, [[Kapp Dendo]]. Winter then returned to the Darklighter farm and wrested a copy of the data disk from Darklighter. The next morning, Janson and the other Rogues took flight in their X-wings, heading for the arms cache location that Winter had decrypted. The cache was actually weapons and gear pirated from the [[Eidolon (Strike-class)|''Eidolon'']], looted by [[Firith Olan]], who launched [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] after them. Handily defeating Olan's fighters, they pursued his ship into space, but the arrival of Imperial fighters, who were also after Olan, prevented them from disabling his craft, and he escaped to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: Battleground: Tatooine" />

While Antilles, Loro, Celchu, and Winter journeyed to Ryloth on a freighter, Janson, Ilo, Nep, and Klivian remained behind on Tatooine. Unfortunately for them, the Empire retrieved Olan before Antilles could and obtained valuable information from him. Upon their return from the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] homeworld, the Rogues were reunited and gained the aid of [[Sixtus Quin]] and his ex-Imperial commandos. Pursuing the Imperials back to the location of the ''Eidolon'', Janson and the other Rogues flew cover while Winter landed Sixtus and his men in a two-pronged attack on the Imperial forces hidden there. Despite Celchu and Ilo being shot down, the X-wing pilots destroyed the TIEs while Sixtus's men successfully secured the base and killed the Imperial leader, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Marl Semtin/Legends|Semtin]].<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: Battleground: Tatooine" />

====Trouble on Eiattu====
{{Quote|They're all over us, Wedge! We can't hold off the troopers ''and'' the TIES!|Wes Janson, to Wedge Antilles|<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: The Warrior Princess">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: The Warrior Princess]]''</ref>}}
Approximately one month after the events on Tatooine, Rogue Squadron received a new recruit by the name of [[Feylis Ardele]]. Ardele was recruited by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] due to her experience and proficiency in flying the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] fighters, and during a training simulation, she managed to shoot down Janson.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: The Warrior Princess" />

While the squadron was getting to know its new pilot, Antilles and Celchu were introduced to the [[Gror Pernon|Grand Duke Gror Pernon]], the uncle of the Rogue's own Plourr Ilo. The Grand Duke told those gathered of the problems being experienced on his homeworld of [[Eiattu 6|Eiattu]], and also of Plourr Ilo's royal lineage&mdash;which effectively made her a Princess of Eiattu. Pernon asked for Rogue Squadron to escort Ilo back to her homeworld so that she could try and mend the wounds of the broken world.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: The Warrior Princess" />

[[File:Wes_and_Hobbie.jpg|thumb|250px|Wes Janson and Derek Klivian during the mission to Eiattu.]]
Janson, along with the remainder of Rogue Squadron, accompanied Ilo on her homeward trek. Once on Eiattu, Janson, Klivian, and a number of the other Rogues decided to ride a group of trained [[thuvasaur]]s and explore the wild countryside. During their sightseeing, Janson and the others came under intense fire from Imperial ground forces who had been in pursuit of the [[People's Liberation Battalion]] (PLB). During the firefight, Janson got in touch with Antilles and requested immediate air support&mdash;the Rogues, accompanied by [[Rial Pernon|Count Rial Pernon]], responded to the call and drove off the Imperial air cover that was strafing Janson and the others. Following the skirmish, Janson and the other grounded Rogues were unable to be extracted, but were instead found by the members of the PLB and taken back to the rebel camp. That night, Janson met the PLB leader [[Harrandatha Estillo|Harran]], who was actually an [[Harrandatha Estillo (impostor)|Imperial spy]]&mdash;the real Harran was Harrandatha Estillo, a deceased prince of Eiattu and the younger brother of Plourr Ilo.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: The Warrior Princess" />

The following day, soldiers of the PLB led the Rogues back the city where Antilles and the others were. Upon arrival, Janson and Hobbie were debriefed by Antilles and Celchu on what had happened during the previous day's firefight, and what they had witnessed during their stay with the PLB. The gathered pilots came to the conclusion that there was something suspicious about the way the Imperials had acted the previous day and that they were probably hiding something in the swampy area. Janson, Klivian, another Rogue pilot named [[Nrin Vakil]], and some of the others organized themselves into a squad and went back to the swamp to aggressively patrol the area for any signs of the Imperials&mdash;however, Janson and his patrol were ambushed by a number of [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]], with Vakil appearing to have been killed. Janson and the patrol, minus Vakil, were captured and taken back to the Imperial stronghold.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: The Warrior Princess" />

While in Imperial custody, Janson learned that Harran was actually an Imperial spy and in league with Moff [[Leonia Tavira]]. Janson's and the others captivity had coincided with a PLB attack and subsequent showdown between Ilo and the spy claiming to be her long-dead brother. Meanwhile, Vakil, who had managed to survive the Imperial ambush, made his way to the prison where the captured Rogues were being detained, and set them free.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: The Warrior Princess" />

The conflict on Eiattu came to an end with the capture of the fake Harran, Moff Tavira being driven from the planet, and with Ilo assuming the royal office and deciding to stay and help fix the planet from which she came.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: The Warrior Princess" />

====Search for the ''Starfaring''====
{{Quote|Something's exerting an influence on us. Intellectually, I know I shouldn't be enjoying myself . . . but I am.|Wes Janson, while at the Bothan camp on [[Malrev IV]]|<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: Requiem for a Rogue">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Requiem for a Rogue]]''</ref>}}
Returning from Eiattu, the Rogues, minus Ilo, were sent to search for the ''[[Starfaring]]'', a ship with a crew of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] that disappeared somewhere in the [[Malrev system/Legends|Malrev system]]. Using his Sullustan hearing, Nep guided the squadron down onto a forested planet to where the ''Starfaring'' was, but they were attacked by a group of TIEs and Antilles was shot down.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: Requiem for a Rogue" />

[[File:Wes_and_female_Bothan.jpg|thumb|left|275px|Wes after spending the night with a female Bothan.]]
Making camp for the night with the Bothans at the ''Starfaring''{{'s}} landing site, Janson and the others planned to search for Wedge the next day. Janson and Klivian were intrigued and attracted to the female Bothan dancers, but were distracted when they went to aid Vakil when he got in a fight with some of the Bothans. Janson and the other Rogues were beaten up, though not severely. Suddenly, the entire camp was attacked by the [[irrukiine]] beasts wielding Imperial blasters and the Rogues and Bothans joined together to beat the beasts off. After the attack, Janson and Celchu stood first watch, though apparently afterwards Janson spent the night with one of the Bothan females. The next day, the Rogues and some of the Bothans went in search of Wedge, but were attacked by irrukiine upon approaching a [[Sith Temple (Malrev IV)|large temple]] that served as a focal point for [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] powers. Janson and the others retreated, and were joined by Antilles, who had escaped captivity in the temple during the confusion of the firefight. However, Klivian and Herian were injured and Nep, drawn to the "music" generated by the temple, remained behind.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: Requiem for a Rogue" />

Wedge took Tycho and Janson on a short flight in their X-wings to get away from the Bothans. Wedge informed them that a Devaronian named [[Cartariun]] was using the temple to control the irrukiine and was trying to take over the world. As they approached the temple from the air, Cartariun sent irrukiine in TIEs after them, guiding the normally-savage beasts with the Force in a manner similar to [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]]. As the Rogues battled through the horde of TIEs, Janson told the others that he was damaged and had his astromech fake damage to the ship, but actually was duping the enemy. His gambit paid off and several TIEs were destroyed that way. The assault was broken off when Nep managed to resist the lure of the Temple long enough to distract Cartariun. Janson and the other airborne Rogues returned to the ''Starfaring'', only to learn that [[Girov Dza'tey]], the Bothan commander, had betrayed them to take over the temple and that Girov was a trained military officer.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: Requiem for a Rogue" />

Wedge conferred with the Bothan second-in-command and convinced him to launch a ground assault while the Rogues attacked the Temple from the air. Janson helped the mostly recovered Klivian into his fighter, and the squadron launched their airborne assault to destroy the temple. Unfortunately for them, Girov had taken over the temple and, as a trained officer, was more adept at controlling the irrukiine and was using TIE Interceptors to augment his firepower. As the battle became more desperate, the injured Herian, in mental contact with Nep, took a grounded X-wing to the temple, guided in by Dllr's mind. Arriving just in time to cover the attack, Plourr Ilo returned with a squadron of [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]]. Herian crashed her ship into the temple, destroying it. The Rogues and Ilo's fighters easily mopped up the remaining fighters, now uncoordinated, but both Herian and Nep perished.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: Requiem for a Rogue" />

====Battle for Brentaal IV====
{{Quote|Always the glutton for punishment, eh, Tycho?|Wes Janson, to Tycho, during a recon mission to Brentaal IV|<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: In the Empire's Service">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: In the Empire's Service]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Wes_and_bomb.jpg|thumb|200px|Wes planting a bomb during the ground attack on Brentaal IV.]]
Following the events in the Malrev system, the Rogues were tasked with performing a reconnaissance sweep in Imperial space of [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] of the [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]]&mdash;Wedge, Vakil, Ilo, Celchu, and Janson were tapped for this mission. Following a short skirmish with a flight of Imperial TIE fighters, Vakil managed to get the information that had been requested on the planets defenses, The sweep was a considered a success.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: In the Empire's Service" />

Once Janson and the others had returned to the Rebel base, Wedge and Tycho were presented with four new pilots to replace the Rogues' depleted ranks. [[Dar Keyis]], [[Standro Jcir]], [[Avan Beruss]], and [[Xarcce Huwla]] were all added to the Rogues' roster. After the new pilots were introduced to the other Rogues and shown to their quarters, Admiral Ackbar advised Antilles and Celchu that Rogue Squadron would be supporting [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm]] and [[Aggressor Wing]] in the upcoming offensive in the Bormea Sector. The plan called for a foothold to be gained by capturing one of Brentaal IV's two moons and using it as a staging area for the larger [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|attack]] against Brentaal IV itself.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: In the Empire's Service" />

Janson and Rogue Squadron, along with Aggressor Squadron, attacked their objective in the Bormea Sector, but were encountered by an unidentified Imperial fighter squadron which began to harry the attacking Rebel starfighters. Shortly after the confrontation began, Klivian's X-wing was unexpectedly hit and he crash-landed on the moon's surface, though not before ejecting from his doomed craft. For the most part, the attack went off without any other trouble and Alliance troopers were able to capture the Imperial hangar on the moon. Once the Rogues and Aggressors had pulled back to the Rebel base at [[Base Delta-Nine|Delta-Nine]] it was discovered that the unidentified Imperial squadron was actually the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group]] which was under the command of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]].<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: In the Empire's Service" />

Following a short rest on Delta-Nine, Janson and the Rogues were transferred to the newly captured Brentaal Moonbase, and were provided a briefing for the upcoming battle. During the briefing it was reported the Fel had recently been spotted on Brentaal IV, and that it was imperative that the Rogues engage and prevent Fel and the 181st from hitting the Alliance ground troops. Not long afterwards, Rogue and Aggressor squadrons flew to Brentaal IV and began the attack&mdash;although the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of [[Oradin]] was captured, Fel and the 181st managed to cause the Rebel forces severe damage. Both Wes Janson and Ibtisam were shot down, and Aggressor Squadron was hit badly, losing a number of its pilots.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: In the Empire's Service" />

Once on the ground, Janson and Ibtisam were recovered by Alliance Intelligence agents led by Kapp Dendo. They were taken to the Intel agents' hidden base and shown the plans for the upcoming attack on [[Vuultin]]. Not long after, the attack began and the Rogues and Aggressors were once again on the offensive. Fel and the 181st engaged the Rebels, and during the fight Standro was shot down and killed. Meanwhile, Dendo, Janson, and Ibtisam led a ground assault against a massive air-defense network that Admiral [[Lon Isoto]] had had constructed. During the assault, Janson received a minor shoulder wound from [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] who were defending the complex. Even though Janson was wounded, he and the others managed to set a number of explosive devices at key points and destroy the air defenses, thus taking pressure off of the attacking Rebel starfighters and allowing Rebel assault ships to land with ground forces. The Rebels managed to capture Brentaal IV and drive the Imperials from the sector&mdash;following the battle, Janson and Ibtisam were reunited with Rogue Squadron. Additionally, the Rebellion captured Baron Soontir Fel,<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: In the Empire's Service" /> and he agreed to fly for the Rebellion.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: The Making of Baron Fel">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 25|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 25]]</ref>

====Mission to Corellia====
Shortly after Fel joined the Rogues, Antilles sent Janson, Klivian and Ilo to Corellia to try and [[Mission to Corellia (Rogue Squadron)|retrieve]] Fel's wife, [[Syal Antilles Fel|Wynssa Starflare]]. The three successfully reached Corellia and made their way to the Fel estate, where they learned from [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] Captain [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] that two-year-old [[Fyric Fel]] had been kidnapped earlier in the day. They left the Fel Estate and returned to their ship, only to have Fyric's mother [[Ajai Fel]] approach and ask them to help her find her child in exchange for the location of Wynssa.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: Family Ties">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Family Ties]]''</ref>

Plourr took charge, arranging a meeting in an alley with the kidnappers. Their [[Ilir Post|leader]] told her that if she beat his [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]], they would trade the money for the child. Ilo defeated the Weequay, but the kidnappers double-crossed them and captured the three Rogues, planning on executing them. Luckily, CorSec agents Horn and [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella Wessiri]] arrived and helped the Rogues defeat the kidnappers, but Post got away.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: Family Ties" />

Returning to their ship, the Rogues and CorSec agents planned a raid on Post's estate to retrieve the child. The assault easily defeated Post's guards, but Post appeared at an upper-story window with a gun to Fyric's head. [[Todr Fel]], armed with a blaster rifle, shot Post through the head and Ilo caught Fyric as he fell. Janson and the other Rogues then retrieved all the Fels from Corellia, departing in their freighter, as Horn promised to delay filing his report. As they left, their freighter was attacked by [[Ugly/Legends|Ugly]] starfighters, and though Janson tried to evade them, their escape was made possible by Corran Horn's skill in an X-wing fighter, shooting down three of the four attackers.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: Family Ties" />

====Escort on Axxila====
[[File:LtWes2.jpg|thumb|180px|Wes Janson during space combat.]]
{{Quote|Hobbie, if you can't shake a T-wing, you deserve to be vaped.|Wes Janson, to Derek Klivian, during space combat|<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: Masquerade">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Masquerade]]''</ref>}}
After their return from Corellia, Janson and the Rogues responded to a distress call, [[Raid on pirates|fending off]] a group of pirates during a training mission. While Celchu and Fel accompanied Princess Leia (actually Winter in disguise), Han Solo, and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to a diplomatic conference on Eiattu and Antilles and the real Leia went to meet with Imperial [[Vizier/Legends|Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] in a secret lair on [[Axxila/Legends|Axxila]], Janson and the other Rogues were elsewhere on Axxila. Recognizing a group of pirates in a cantina as ones they had fought earlier, they followed them back to their hangar, but the encounter turned violent when the pirates realized they were there. Also, a different group of the same pirate organization captured Celchu and Winter on Eiattu and brought them to Axxila also, but the two eventually escaped in a Y-wing. This was not to be the last time the Rogues encountered [[Kavil's Corsairs]], who were in fact led by Leonia Tavira, the Moff they had encountered on Eiattu.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: Masquerade" />

Responding to Celchu's call for help, Janson and the some of the other Rogues scrambled in their fighters and cleared the pirate fighters off of Tycho while the other pilots fought with some of the pilots on the ground. They were still heavily outnumbered, but the arrival of the ''Millennium Falcon'' with Solo and Fel aboard helped even the odds and the entire group was reunited at the Rogue Squadron hangar on Axxila. However, the arrival of Admiral [[Delak Krennel]] and the [[Reckoning (Imperial II-class)|''Reckoning'']] disrupted their plans, forcing them to go to ground. Fel and Celchu captured a TIE fighter and a secure Imperial comlink, and Fel gave Krennel an [[AT3 Directive]] to withdraw from Axxila long enough for them to escape. With Krennel gone, the ''Falcon'' and the Rogues left Axxila, their mission completed.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: Masquerade" />

====Extraction from Ciutric====
{{Quote|Got her on my scopes pal. Why don't you go sit out of the way and watch a master work.|Wes Janson, telling Hobbie of his intentions towards Reina Faleur|<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: Mandatory Retirement">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Mandatory Retirement]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Hobbie_Wes_RR.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Hobbie and Janson enjoying some R&R.]]
After their mission to Axxila, the Rogues earned some R&R, during which Janson tried to solicit the attentions of an attractive female officer named [[Reina Faleur]], only to find that she already had a date&mdash;with Antilles. However, their vacation was cut short by an urgent mission to rescue Sate Pestage, who had been compromised by [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]] for his deal with Organa. Admiral Ackbar assigned Rogue Squadron to work with Winter and Kapp Dendo to retrieve Pestage from [[Ciutric IV]]. Janson and the other Rogues, along with Aggressor Wing, entered the space around Ciutric and targeted the local fighters while Dendo's men retrieved Pestage. With friendly ground troops taking fire, the Rogues also provided close air support to the commandos. As they were making their escape, they were trapped by the ''Reckoning'' and the Interdictor ''[[Binder]]''. The Rogues, Dendo's troops, and Pestage fled to the night side of Ciutric while Aggressor made their escape to get help.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: Mandatory Retirement" />

Pinned down on groundside, Antilles had Dendo's men take an Imperial communications outpost so he could get a message out. However, they still had to fend off TIE fighters hunting them, and Ibtisam was shot down and killed during a dogfight, which also informed Krennel of their location. The Rogues were swarmed by TIEs from the ''Reckoning'', but some help arrived in the form of Mirax Terrik in the ''[[Pulsar Skate]]'' and Aggressor Wing with General Horton Salm, and though Janson's R2 unit was shot out in the fight, no other pilots were killed or shot down.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: Mandatory Retirement" />

Mirax and Antilles planned an assault on ''Binder'' and ''Reckoning'' to allow Dendo's men to escape with Pestage, and used the ''Pulsar Skate'' as a decoy. While the pilots dealt with the capital ships and fighters, Dendo's team fled from Imperial ground troops pursuing them, but Pestage deserted them for the Imperial forces and Krennel. He paid for his treachery when Krennel crushed his throat and became a new warlord, one of many in the fractured Empire.<ref name="X-wing Rogue Squadron: Mandatory Retirement" />

====Service over Mindor====
{{Quote|Just had to get a few shots. You look like some weird cross between a starfighter pilot and a Batravian gumplucker.''"<br />"''Wes, I don't even know what that is.''"<br />"''Sure you do, Hobbie. A starfighter pilot is a guy who flies an X-wing without getting blown up. Check the Basic Dictionary. Though I can understand how you get confused.|Wes Janson and Derek "Hobbie" Klivian after the latter's craft was disabled|<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>}}
Shortly thereafter, [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] being flown by a warlord known as [[Cronal|Shadowspawn]] began raiding a number of merchant ships. The fighters proved difficult for the New Republic to track down and none of the pilots had been taken alive, so Commander Antilles devised a plan that had Rogue Squadron disguise themselves inside a hollowed-out shell that resembled the luxury liner ''[[Corellian Queen]]''. After the ship's route had been relayed to Shadowspawn's forces, a group of TIE Defenders arrived to intercept the craft. Janson participated in the subsequent ambush, shooting down at least one TIE Defender with [[Flechette torpedo|specially modified torpedoes]] that exploded into hundreds of metal flechettes. His wingman, Klivian, had his fighter disabled in the skirmish, and after the remaining Defenders fled, Janson returned to retrieve his wingman, who was drifting in space. As he pulled his fighter alongside Klivian's in preparation for attaching a tow cable, Janson took the opportunity to take several images of the hapless Klivian sitting in his craft, plugging breaches in his cockpit with the severed ends of his artificial limbs, which was much to the merry Taanabian lieutenant's delight, and little to Klivian's.<ref name="Mindor" />

Following their successful mission, the Rogues assisted in bringing [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] [[Fenn Shysa]] to the world of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] for a series of negotiations with other [[Mandalorian Supercommando]]s. Janson later accompanied Rogue Squadron to the world of [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]], which had been revealed by a transponder contained in the torpedo flechettes of the Rogues to be the stronghold of Shadowspawn and where Luke Skywalker had led the [[Rapid Response Task Force]] in order to deal with the warlord. The Rogues arrived later, escorting Leia Organa to Mindor after the Rapid Response Task Force had failed to contact anyone else and following a rescue attempt led by Chewbacca and Han Solo on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. They soon found that the Rapid Response Task Force was being battered by waves of Shadowspawn's starfighters after having been damaged by [[Gravity mine/Legends|gravity mines]].<ref name="Mindor" />

Organa soon boarded the ''Falcon'' and headed for the surface, where Skywalker's cruiser, [[Justice (MC80 Star Cruiser)|''Justice'']], had crashed. Rogue Squadron was called upon to guide them through the belt of asteroids surrounding Mindor, which were swarming with hostile starfighters. After the ''Falcon'' landed, the squadron battled their way back up into orbit, attempting to clear an escape path through the mines and hostile fighters. They were able to use their craft's repulsorlifts to use the orbital debris around Mindor to their advantage, knocking large pieces of rock into nearby hostile starfighters, who were not equipped with repulsorlifts. The Rogues were also charged with aiding the remaining ships of the Rapid Response Task Force in fending off waves of starfighters, many of whom made suicide runs against the New Republic vessels. The New Republic flotilla did receive reinforcements in the form of a [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] commanded by General [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who took command of the beleaguered fleet.<ref name="Mindor" />

However, as orbital debris was triggering stellar flares in Mindor's sun, [[Taspan]], Janson, the Rogues, and the rest of the New Republic fleet were ordered by Calrissian to descend towards Mindor's surface, using it as a shield from the surges of intense radiation pulsing from the star. From there, the New Republic launched an assault on Shadowspawn's base, attempting to seize the anti-orbital weapons before Mindor rotated enough to bring them to bear against the surviving New Republic fleet. The Rogues flew cover for the assault, but were forced away after the dormant volcano around which the installation was built was blasted into space by gravitic effects. Skywalker, who had infiltrated Shadowspawn's base, managed to order the Imperial troops to take his orders, as they believed that he was the Emperor. The Jedi ordered the Imperial troops to stand down, and the New Republic vessels began evacuating personnel from the flying volcano, when Shadowspawn regained control over the Imperial stormtroopers and starfighter pilots, ordering them to make suicidal attacks on the New Republic presence. As the TIEs turned to attack, Janson was part of a desperate defense that attempted to destroy as many TIE fighters as possible before they rammed into the New Republic vessels. Skywalker eventually was able to cut off Shadowspawn's control, which slew the rest of the Imperials and allowed the New Republic forces to escape the system.<ref name="Mindor" />

===Wraith Squadron===
{{Quote|Oh, wonderful. I killed his father. He hates me. He knows how to make ''bombs.'' Come on, Wedge, how does this story end?|Wes Janson, talking about Kell Tainer|<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />}}
[[File:Lt.Wes.jpg|thumb|200px|Lieutenant Wes Janson.]]
Eventually, Janson and his good friend Derek Klivian left frontline combat duty and were tasked with building and training new starfighter units, resulting in the creation of both [[Corsair Squadron]] and [[Gauntlet Squadron]], as well as the ill-fated [[Talon Squadron (New Republic)|Talon Squadron]].<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" /> As an experienced pilot, Janson's services as a trainer were highly sought.<ref name="Handbook 1: X-Wing Rogue Squadron">[[Star Wars Handbook 1: X-Wing Rogue Squadron|''Star Wars Handbook'' 1: ''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>

When Wedge Antilles and the rest of the reformed Rogue Squadron left the New Republic to hunt down Ysanne Isard, the New Republic needed a Rogue Squadron to keep up appearances of the famous X-wing unit. In response, they created a temporary Rogue Squadron led by Klivian and Janson and filled by former Rogues and new recruits. After Antilles' return from [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]], this squadron met them over Coruscant, demonstrating their formation flying prowess before landing. Once the Rogues were reinstated into the New Republic, the ersatz squadron was disbanded, and some of its members incorporated into the returning Rogues. Janson (along with Klivian) was officially restored to active duty in Rogue Squadron by High Command as a reward for assembling the temporary replacements.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />

Shortly after, Antilles put Rogue Squadron under the command of Tycho Celchu and Klivian while he and Janson formed a new unit, [[Wraith Squadron]], with Janson as the executive officer. Wraith Squadron was an experimental group comprised largely of rejected pilots and wash-outs that doubled as both a commando unit and a starfighter squadron. Antilles felt that this sort of unit was necessary after his experiences against Isard and well-suited to the overall New Republic campaign to wipe out the most prominent Imperial warlords, particularly Warlord [[Zsinj]]. Janson served as Antilles' second in command of Wraith Squadron and helped select the squadron members. Antilles also told Janson and Klivian of the destruction of Talon Squadron and brought in the only survivor, [[Myn Donos]] into the Wraiths.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />

One of the ironies of the Wraiths came to fruition when a man by the name of [[Kell Tainer]] was selected for the squadron, with a specialty in demolitions. He was the son of the late Kissek Doran and had changed his name when word reached him that his father had turned coward in the middle of battle. There was much angst between Janson and Tainer at first, but as the campaign against Zsinj and his affiliates wore on, the two came to terms with one another, especially when Janson and Tainer both realized that the stiffness around each other wasn't a sign of aggression, but of fear. The two pilots eventually resolved their differences and dropped their long-standing hostility and mistrust of the other.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />

Janson was one of the chief training officers for the new squadron, putting the pilots through a series of exercises that challenged their skill and their ability to adapt to situations. On a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] drill, he arranged for their fighters to lose targeting, forcing them to aim manually and on another instance, dictated that each pilot was graded by the performance of their wingman. The training process whittled down the number of candidates until there were ten new pilots in the finalized squadron roster, at the time dubbed Gray Squadron. Janson was assigned as Gray Eleven and given command of Three Flight.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />

====Night Caller====
{{Quote|Why isn't Hobbie here to take this abuse?|Wes Janson, being pranked by his fellow Wraiths|<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />}}
Gray Squadron (shortly renamed "Wraiths" by [[Tyria Sarkin Tainer|Tyria Sarkin]]) were originally based at [[Folor]], but were forced to evacuate when Zsinj-allied Admiral [[Apwar Trigit]] attacked. The Wraiths, having barely finished their training hastily evacuated. Janson helped escort the straggling freighter [[Borleias (transport)|''Borleias'']], shooting several TIEs off of it. However, they were pulled out of hyperspace by an [[Empion mine]] which also disabled their X-wings. Janson and most of the squadron set down on the hostile world of [[Xobome 6]] to effect makeshift repairs. Thanks to some unorthodox tactics and improvised weaponry, the Wraiths left in orbit were able to capture a mine-laying vessel, the [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']]. Posing as the actual crew of the vessel, Janson and the other Wraiths used the ship to gather intelligence on Trigit's and [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s activities. A rendezvous with New Republic forces allowed them to become officially commissioned as a squadron and they renamed themselves Wraith Squadron, but Janson and Antilles grew concerned about the lack of emotional and personal stability among some of the pilots, such as Kell Tainer and [[Tyria Sarkin Tainer|Tyria Sarkin]]. The former at this point still demonstrated visible unease around Janson and the latter had attacked another pilot after being asked to consider cheating to improve her scores. It seemed to Janson that this group of rejects and wash-outs might be headed for disaster.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />

Wedge and Janson, as senior officers, stayed somewhat aloof from the other pilots, interacting with them only in an official manner. The Wraiths conducted several infiltration and intelligence gathering missions on Zsinj-allied businesses, including a commando raid on [[Xartun]]. On this mission, Janson and the other Wraiths broke into a production facility that had been shown earlier to a disguised Loran and sabotaged it. While stormtroopers attempted to attack the intrusion party, Janson held them off until the rest of the intruders could rejoin them. They escaped just before the destruction of the Zsinj-allied production facility.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />

During their ''Night Caller'' charade, the Wraiths suffered their first casualty, [[Jesmin Ackbar]], when a group of pirates attacked them. Janson and the others fended off the attack, with Janson scoring an aerial kill and helping compel the swift surrender of the pirates. However, despite the loss, their missions continued and Janson was able to resolve his difficulties with Tainer as well. Following their success, they were contacted by Zsinj, who ordered the ersatz ''Night Caller'' crew to help attack the New Republic alongside Admiral Trigit.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />

On a subsequent infiltration mission to [[Storinal]], Janson posed as an expatriated [[Bakura/Legends|Bakuran]] Senator, helping infect an Imperial shuttle with [[Bunkurd Sewer Disorder]], which led to a supply ship that was supposed to rendezvous with ''Night Caller'' being infected and thus unable to expose their cover. The mission also resulted in the Wraiths stealing two TIE fighters to equip the ''Night Caller'' with. The Wraiths then engaged another corvette and a frigate belonging to Zsinj in the [[Battle of Talasea]], and were able to maintain the charade of being Zsinj's crewmen by pretending they had barely survived the engagement that had destroyed the corvette and frigate.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />

The culmination of their ''Night Caller'' escapades was the ambush and destruction of the Star Destroyer [[Implacable (Star Destroyer)/Legends|''Implacable'']], commanded by Apwar Trigit. The Wraiths led Trigit and his Star Destroyer to attack what was ostensibly a defense of a Zsinj-allied business on [[Ession]], but was actually a New Republic trap. In that [[Battle of Ession|battle]], Janson scored several combat kills, but was unable to rescue Wraiths [[Eurrsk Thri'ag|Grinder]] or [[Falynn Sandskimmer]], who had flown into a hole in the Star Destroyer's power cells to destroy it from within, and both perished, though the Star Destroyer and Admiral Trigit also were destroyed.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />

====Hawk-Bats====
{{Quote|Bad news: I'm back. Bad for me, because I was enjoying my rest, and bad for you, because if some of you had been a little quicker, I wouldn't have been shot.|Wes Janson, briefing the squadron upon his recovery|<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Wes_janson.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Wes Janson during the early days of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]]]
Returning to Coruscant for some downtime, the Wraiths narrowly escaped capture by a group of impostors posing as military police after they got into a bar fight, and Janson suffered a blaster graze along his ribs in a brawl with the impostors, but the wound was not serious. After their successful use of the ''Night Caller'', the Wraiths decided to pose as a pirate group, the [[Hawk-bat Independent Space Force|Hawk-Bats]], to cause further damage to Zsinj as well as gather more information. In their first [[Halmad campaign|mission]], they stole several TIE Interceptors from an Imperial base to complete their squadron's complement of starfighters&mdash;they had not received replacements since sustaining losses and they needed craft for their piratical charade. Janson participated in the mission on the ground, using his blaster skills to good effect by shooting several stormtroopers. In between missions, Janson returned to Coruscant to pick up cargo and orders for the Wraiths, and also a stuffed Ewok doll that would play heavily into his tricks. Meanwhile, several members of the squadron posed as the Hawk-bats, wreaking havoc on the relatively defenseless world of [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]] in order to persuade the locals to seek aid from Zsinj, thus drawing him out.<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" />

On his next mission, Janson, paired with new member [[Dia Passik]], joined in a dogfight over Halmad with a large group of starfighters from the recently arrived [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']], Warlord Zsinj's flagship. The Wraiths largely escaped, save for [[Ton Phanan]] who was shot down and later died. To facilitate their escape, they destroyed a refueling tanker that ''Iron Fist'' had tractor beamed, causing damage to the hangar bay. This action also caused Zsinj to offer employment to the Hawk-Bats. However, the grueling missions, coupled with recent casualties, wore the Wraiths down.<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" />

Janson was kept busy working with Antilles to maintain stability among the unit and interpreting data to use against Zsinj. While analyzing the defenses of Zsinj's target, Janson believed that the target was Coruscant, but Antilles correctly determined that it was actually the shipyards at [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], and Zsinj was trying to steal the newest [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] in production there. Janson also helped set Dia Passik, his wingmate, up with [[Garik Loran|Garik "Face" Loran]] at a formal dance, and the two later developed a romantic relationship.<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" />

During Zsinj's [[Battle of Kuat (Hunt for Zsinj)|attempt]] to steal the new warship, Janson and several of the Wraiths stayed on [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Mon Remonda/Legends|Mon Remonda]]'' in their X-wings as part of an anti-Zsinj task force under Han Solo in order to ambush Zsinj in his escape from Kuat while other Wraith pilots infiltrated the new battleship and served as pirates flying for Zsinj. The mission and subsequent [[Battle for the Razor's Kiss|ambush]], which Janson took part in, was largely a success, with the ''[[Razor's Kiss]]'' destroyed, although ''Iron Fist'' escaped.<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" />

====Defeat of Zsinj====
{{Quote|Yub, yub, Commander.|Wes Janson, teasing Wedge Antilles with an Ewok joke|<ref name="X-Wing: Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>}}
With the ''Razor's Kiss'' destroyed, the Wraiths abandoned their Hawk-Bats scheme temporarily and rejoined Han Solo's flagship, the ''Mon Remonda'', while continuing their intelligence and sabotage missions. Wraith Squadron at this point was reorganized, with Garik Loran being promoted to the commander of the unit. Although Janson was the senior officer of the two lieutenants, he had never wanted (or intended) to stay with the Wraiths past their initial formation period, and was perfectly at ease taking orders from the much younger officer, remaining XO of the unit. And although Antilles technically rejoined Rogue Squadron at this point, it did not even slow down Janson from his continuous teasing and practical jokes against the commander.

The Wraiths then continued their activities as part of Solo's fleet, which led to Zsinj engaging Solo's force in a major battle in order to eliminate what had become a nuisance to the warlord. In a [[Battle of Levian Two|fleet battle]] against a large part of Zsinj's fleet, including ''Iron Fist'', Janson, the Wraiths and the Rogues destroyed two [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class cruisers]], but Janson's craft was disabled by an ion cannon. He was rescued, and Solo's fleet escaped to fight another day.<ref name="X-Wing: Solo Command" />

[[File:InsiderJanson.jpg|thumb|200px|Janson in his flight suit.]]
The Wraiths then decided to follow up on new leads to explore the empire of businesses that Zsinj seemed to be amassing to support his military. On an intelligence gathering [[Mission to Saffalore|mission]] to [[Saffalore]], the Wraiths investigated [[Binring Biomedical Product|Binring Biomedical]], but were ambushed by Zsinj's forces after being funneled into a trap. Janson was burned when the Wraiths fell through a trapdoor into a crematorium, but they escaped, capturing Dr. [[Edda Gast]], a top [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] for Zsinj, in the process, despite moderate injuries to most of the pilots. Janson later earned a commendation for bravery for his actions, which he received after finishing [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] therapy. In response, Zsinj activated a number of sleeper agents in an [[Project Funeral|effort]] to kill numerous high-profile New Republic leaders. After Wraith Tyria Sarkin was forced to shoot down a brainwashed [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] pilot trying to kill Han Solo, Janson was able to talk with her and help her recover, due to his own experience of shooting down a friendly pilot.<ref name="X-Wing: Solo Command" />

On a mission to [[Kidriff 5]], Janson and three other pilots flew TIE Interceptors to ascertain the security of the planet, and later linked up with a decoy [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]] freighter dubbed the ''[[Millennium Falsehood]]'' in mimicry of the ''Millennium Falcon'' as a lure for Zsinj. Once they were reunited, Janson and the other Wraiths and Rogues covered the ''Falsehood'' on its egress from the planet, pursued by enemy starfighters, which they [[Raid on Kidriff 5|engaged]] and fended off. During the last stages of the battle, Wraith pilot Myn Donos deliberately fired on a fellow Wraith, [[Gara Petothel|Lara Notsil]], after Garik Loran unintentionally revealed that Notsil had been an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent directly responsible for the destruction of Donos's Talon Squadron before Notsil had defected. Notsil escaped, fleeing to Zsinj as a double agent, and the Wraiths returned to ''Mon Remonda.'' Donos was placed on probation, and eventually sought advice from Janson, who convinced him to have fun and let himself go more often. The advice helped, and Donos eventually returned to active flying status. Janson was also the target of Wedge's revenge for his many pranks when he was tricked into walking naked into a room with all the Wraiths inside.<ref name="X-Wing: Solo Command" />

Janson, still in a TIE Interceptor (his X-wing being used by members of Wraith Squadron who did not have their own fighter, nor TIE fighter experience), and the Wraiths would later fly escort missions for [[Nova Squadron/Legends|Nova Squadron's]] [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighters]] in attacks on ''Iron Fist'' in the [[Battle of Vahaba]] and the subsequent [[Battle of Selaggis]], the latter made possible by the efforts of Wraith Squadron member Lara Notsil, who had pretended to join Zsinj so she could sabotage and kill him from within his organization. In the battles, Janson destroyed several more TIE Interceptors.<ref name="X-Wing: Solo Command" /> Zsinj's fleet was crippled at [[Selaggis system/Legends|Selaggis]] and the warlord was killed by Han Solo not long afterward, ending that campaign.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

===Return to Rogue Squadron===
{{Quote|I'm coming back to Rogue Squadron. That was the deal.''"<br />"''Wes, the Wraiths don't want you anyway.''"<br />"''That's right. You're unlucky.''"<br />"''I hate how serious he is all the time.''"<br />"''We don't like the way he chews his food.''"<br />"''But we'll miss his rear end.|Wes Janson, Wedge Antilles, and fellow Wraiths [[Elassar Targon]], [[Dia Passik]], [[Hohass Ekwesh|Runt]], and [[Shalla Nelprin]]|<ref name="X-Wing: Solo Command" />}}
[[File:Janson_ThrawnSB.jpg|left|thumb|Janson during the Thrawn crisis]]
Upon his return to Rogue Squadron, Janson participated in the [[Thrawn campaign]], culminating in the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]]. Shortly before the Bilbringi mission, he, Antilles, Klivian, and Celchu were part of a New Republic disinformation attempt to convince the Empire that [[Tangrene]] was the original target. They encountered [[Aves]], a member of the [[Talon Karrde]] criminal organization, and convinced him that their target was Tangrene. Janson believed that Aves was going to sell the information to the Empire, but little did they know that a massive smuggler force was going to hit Bilbringi also. The cooperation of the two sides and the death of [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] allowed the New Republic to be successful in the battle.<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>

With Thrawn's assassination and the Empire again retreating, the New Republic decided to launch an offensive against [[Prince-Admiral/Legends|Prince-Admiral]] Delak Krennel's [[Ciutric Hegemony]] as an example to the other Imperial warlords. Following the Thrawn campaign, Admiral Ackbar insisted on promotions for several members of the squadron, including Janson to [[Major/Legends|Major]] along with Klivian, and led to Janson assuming command of Two Flight of the Rogues. As preparations for the Ciutric campaign geared, Janson also participated in a raid on [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] to help free some of the ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' prisoners after a prisoner named [[Urlor Sette]] showed up at a Rogue Squadron victory celebration and was gorily killed by a device planted in him. Janson and the Rogues were able to easily defeat the meager resistance on the ground, and intelligence garnered from the rescued prisoners revealed that Ysanne Isard, believed to be dead over Thyferra, was still alive.<ref name="X-Wing: Isard's Revenge">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref>

Janson flew in the [[Battle of Liinade III]], helping engage Krennel's TIEs in space and then making runs against ground targets in preparation for the New Republic's occupation of the world. Upon learning of the possibility of a [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]-like [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] being constructed near or inside nearby [[Distna]], the Rogues and Nrin Vakil were assigned to reconnoiter the system, with Janson predicting that they would later finish the job by killing the superweapon.<ref name="X-Wing: Isard's Revenge" />
However, the entire superweapon was a hoax designed to kill the Rogues. Upon arrival, they were [[Battle of Distna|ambushed]] by six squadrons of TIE fighters. In the ensuing battle, Janson acquitted himself well, as did the rest of the squadron, but was shot down, and left drifting in vacuum. While the rest of the surviving Rogues were rescued by a group of TIE Defender pilots, Janson was stranded, fated to die of exposure. The timely arrival of the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'' saved him, as [[Booster Terrik]]'s investigative team had discovered Krennel's trap. Terrick's crew recovered Janson and he recovered with the aid of bacta. However, Antilles and the other Rogue pilots were rescued and taken elsewhere by the Defender pilots. They assumed Janson had died.<ref name="X-Wing: Isard's Revenge" />

After the [[Battle of Ciutric]] and defeat of Krennel, Janson was happily reunited with the other Rogues, who had covertly infiltrated Krennel's forces posing as TIE Defender pilots. Antilles, in particular, was quite pleased to see his long-time friend alive and well.<ref name="X-Wing: Isard's Revenge" />

Following his recovery, Janson continued to serve in Rogue Squadron, which helped in the fight against the [[Invids|Invid]] pirate group. Janson helped disable the ''[[Booty Full]]'' after it tried to attack the liner ''[[Glitterstar]]''. That was not the Rogues' only run-in with the Invids, either. The squadron was also present at the [[Battle of Xa Fel (11 ABY)|Battle of Xa Fel]], where the Invids attempted to engage a New Republic force blockading the planet.<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>

====Mission to Adumar====
{{Quote|I am so glad the people of this planet like to wave and shake hands.''"<br />"''Why is that?''"<br />"''Well, what if their usual greeting for visiting dignitaries was to throw paint?''"<br />"''Point taken.|Wes Janson and Wedge Antilles|<ref name="X-wing: Starfighters of Adumar" />}}
In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], Antilles was selected by the New Republic to be sent as an ambassador from the New Republic to [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. Wedge was instructed to bring along three of the New Republic's best starfighter pilots. Celchu, Klivian and Janson were chosen to accompany Antilles. The four soon, under the designation of [[Red Flight]], landed in the largest nation of Adumar, [[Cartann]], where they met with Tomer Darpen, their diplomatic liaison, the documentarian [[Hallis Saper]], and their local guide [[Cheriss ke Hanadi]]. Janson had known Darpen from his days in the Tierfon Yellow Aces, jokingly referring to him as "Ejector" Darpen from an ejection seat mishap during Darpen's combat days. The four pilots were invited to a state dinner, where they were well-received and feted courtesy of Cartann. Janson was quick to adopt local customs, such as the [[blastsword]], and wild clothing tastes, including cloaks that glowed and had flatscreen panels sewn onto them.<ref name="X-wing: Starfighters of Adumar" />

[[File:Adumarbattle.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Janson, Tycho, Hobbie, and Wedge taking their X-wings into battle on Adumar]]
The mission was quickly complicated when the New Republic pilots learned of the Adumari fascination with death duels, on ground and in the air, and of the presence of Imperial 181st pilots competing with them for the Adumari's regard. The Red Flight pilots were also hampered by the subversion of Darpen, who was trying to manipulate them. Another complication was an assault on them by four assailants, who were swiftly defeated. Still, the pilots tried to represent the New Republic well, flying the local [[Blade-32 superiority fighter]]s in practice duels against each other as well as against Adumari pilots. Although they had initially been honored guests of Adumar, showered with gifts, attention, nicknames, (Janson was "the darling one") and of course, demonstrating their skills as pilots, Antilles and the others grew increasingly disturbed by the situation on Adumar. Having learned that [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] agent and a former romantic interest of his, Iella Wessiri, was undercover on Adumar, Antilles asked Janson to accompany him to Wessiri's residence. Janson agreed, though Antilles left him outside her apartment to stand watch while Antilles stayed the entire night with Wessiri as the two renewed their relationship. The next day, Janson's and Antilles' difficulties grew even after a visit to [[Allegiance (Imperial I-class)|''Allegiance'']], the New Republic Star Destroyer in orbit. The Adumari fascination with casually engaging in lethal honor duels disgusted the pilots. When their guide, ke Hanadi, who had been smitten with Antilles, learned that he was newly engaged with Wessiri, she engaged herself in an endless string of duels in an attempt to throw her life away. Janson intervened after she was injured in a duel, insulting and defeating [[Thanaer ke Sekae]] in a blastsword duel.<ref name="X-wing: Starfighters of Adumar" />

However, the situation for the New Republic continued to deteriorate. Their relationship with Cartann was ruined when the ''[[perator]]'' of Cartann announced that he was creating a planetary government, annexing all other nations of Adumar. While the Imperial pilots agreed to join him, the four Rogues declined the offer. Darpen then betrayed the Rogues, goading the ''perator'' to send them to their deaths and cutting off communications with ''Allegiance'' that had brought them to Adumar. As their punishment, they were forced to run the gauntlet of armed citizenry eager for the honor of killing them. Janson and the other Rogues had to dodge the blasters of over a hundred people, escaping down the streets of Cartann's capital to a local airbase, where Blade-32s awaited them to take them to ''Allegiance''. Janson's skills with a blaster pistol were valuable in their running of the gauntlet of mob fire, killing or injuring many of their attackers. Boarding their Blades, Red Flight engaged in a desperate 4 on 30 dogfight against Adumari fighters, emerging victorious, but with all of their craft too badly damaged to reach space. Janson was shot down, but ejected and he and Klivian escaped on the ground. The intervention of sympathetic Adumari pilots allowed the other Rogues to escape, and the help of New Republic Intelligence agent Iella Wessiri allowed them to escape to a friendly nation threatened by Cartann.<ref name="X-wing: Starfighters of Adumar" />

====Adumari Civil War====
{{Quote|Your ability to talk people into wanting to kill you borders on some kind of Jedi thing, you know that?|Derek Klivian, to Wes Janson|<ref name="Adumar: Pilots Wanted">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040401adumarmain|text=Adumar: Pilots Wanted|int=Adumar: Pilots Wanted}}</ref>}}
